subject: MSA/Order Form – Liability cap, prepaid refunds, and wind-down assistance
messages:

To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@acme-corp.com, michael.lee@acme-corp.com

Subject: ACME MSA redlines (Liability + Refunds)

Neha / Karthik —

Thanks for the call yesterday. Attaching ACME's consolidated redlines to the MSA and the Order Form. High-level asks:
- Increase overall liability cap to USD 5M (rather than 3x fees).
- Exclude loss types including indemnified claims and certain breach scenarios.
- Specific carve-out for refunding prepaid fees on termination: ACME wants full refund of unused prepaid amounts within 30 days, plus 30 days of wind-down assistance at no additional charge.
- Consequential damages: we propose mutual waiver, but ACME requests carve-outs for data breach and personal injury.

We know this is a few items to reconcile quickly as the procurement team is on a tight board schedule. Can you confirm Redwood's position on the LoL cap and the prepaid refund obligation?

Attachments: ACME_MSA_Redlines_v3.docx, OrderForm_ACME_2027-04.pdf

Cheers,
Sarah Nguyen
Director, Procurement — Acme Corp
Contracts: contracts@acme-corp.com

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME MSA redlines (Liability + Refunds)

Sarah —

Thanks for sending. We reviewed the redlines with legal and sales leadership this morning. Quick read: the LoL cap increase and the request for full prepaid refunds + free 30-day wind-down assistance are the two primary sticking points.

Operational constraints: our Dedicated/private customers often prepay for capacity; blanket full refunds plus mandatory free wind-down assistance create a material operational and cost exposure (SLA, reserved GPU pools, staff support).

Proposed path to narrow scope before legal redline exchange:
1) Liability cap: Redwood is open to a higher absolute cap for this deal, but we prefer a formula (e.g., greater of USD 3M or 3x monthly run rate) rather than a flat USD 5M.
2) Prepaid refunds: agree to prorated refunds for unused time, subject to reasonable deductions for documented wind-down costs (staffing, data egress, committed third-party infra) and a 30-day notice period.
3) Wind-down assistance: willing to include 15 business days of standard transition support at no charge; additional hands-on support can be provided as a paid professional services add-on or limited by a capped number of engineering hours.
4) Consequential damages: Redwood will preserve data-breach and personal-injury carve-outs as exceptions to the waiver where liability is otherwise permitted.

Lauren and I will propose tracked changes and a short comment sheet. Can we lock a call tomorrow 9am PT to go through with your legal team?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0127

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: proposed legal positions (LoL & refunds)

Team —

Uploading a quick digest of legal positions after review of ACME redlines. Key recommendations (summary):
- Liability cap: counter to ACME with formulaic cap — "Limit of Liability" = greater of USD 3,000,000 or 3x (average monthly fees paid in the prior 3 months), per 12-month rolling period. Rationale: ties cap to spend, limits exposure for low-spend early-stage usage, accommodates growth.
- Exclusions & consequential damages: maintain standard mutual waiver of consequential damages with carve-outs for: (i) indemnified claims, (ii) third-party IP claims, (iii) willful misconduct, (iv) personal injury, and (v) data breach where statutory/regulatory liability applies.
- Prepaid refund mechanics: accept prorated refund of unused prepaid amounts less documented wind-down costs. Wind-down costs should be limited to reasonably incurred costs directly tied to extracting ACME's workloads (data egress bandwidth, one-time engineer support up to a capped number of hours, third-party termination fees). Require ACME to request termination and provide 30-day notice to reduce scope.
- Wind‑down assistance: offer 15 business days of complimentary support (email/Slack + limited runbook handover) and an optional fixed-price 30-day transition package (SOW) if they need deeper lift-and-shift assistance.

I attached a short spreadsheet that models the cost impact under a few prepaid scenarios (LoL_Summary_Table.xlsx).

If leadership agrees to these guardrails, I can produce tracked changes to return to ACME. Karthik / Neha: want to align on commercial concession (if any) before we send to them.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Senior Counsel, Contracts — Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: proposed legal positions (LoL & refunds)

Team —

Echoing Lauren's positions. From a deal perspective, we have flexibility on the numeric cap if we get clarity on: (a) prepaid dollars at signing; (b) intended deployment type (hosted API vs dedicated pool); and (c) willingness to buy a transition package. If ACME is choosing Dedicated with reserved capacity, their request for a unilateral free 30-day wind-down is a material ask.

Commercial ask from me: offer a firm cap uplift to USD 4M (one-time concession) if ACME agrees to: (i) prorated refunds less wind-down deductions, (ii) 15 business days complimentary support, and (iii) purchase of the 30-day transition package at a fixed discounted price if they need it. We can present the uplift as a limited-time signing incentive.

Neha — happy to lead the commercial messaging on the call with ACME.

— Karthik
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 17:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME MSA redlines (Liability + Refunds) — proposed compromise

Sarah —

Thanks for patience while we pulled internal counsel and commercial together. Proposed compromise below for ACME review (we'll send tracked MSA + Order Form after you confirm these principles):

1) Liability cap
   - Limit of Liability = greater of (i) USD 4,000,000 or (ii) 3x the monthly run-rate averaged over the 3 months prior to the triggering event, calculated on a rolling 12-month basis. (We are offering USD 4M cap as a one-time commercial concession.)

2) Prepaid refunds on termination
   - Redwood agrees to prorated refunds for unused prepaid amounts measured from the effective date of termination.
   - Deductions permitted: documented wind-down costs reasonably incurred (data egress, committed third-party termination fees, and up to 80 engineer hours at standard rates). Redwood will provide an itemized invoice for such costs and refund the remaining balance within 30 days.

3) Wind-down assistance
   - Redwood will provide up to 15 business days of no-cost transition support (email/Slack triage + runbook handover).
   - If ACME requires deeper hands-on support, Redwood will offer a fixed-price 30-day transition SOW at a discounted rate (details to be included in Order Form addendum).

4) Consequential damages & carve-outs
   - Standard mutual waiver of consequential damages will remain in place. Carve-outs apply for: (i) indemnified claims; (ii) willful misconduct; (iii) personal injury; and (iv) statutorily-imposed data-breach liabilities.

5) Next steps
   - If ACME signs off on these principles, we'll upload tracked changes to the MSA (ACME_MSA_Redlines_v3.docx -> Redwood_Tracked_v1.docx) and update the Order Form to reflect the refund mechanics and the optional transition package price.
   - Proposed call to finalize: Thu, 15 Apr 2027, 9:00am PT. Please confirm availability.

If ACME can accept this package, Karithk and I will present the concession (USD 4M cap) as a limited signing incentive and we can move to DocuSign.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0127
